## Verification (landed tree)

All 17 AC re-run against the landed tree. 19ba landed as **two** commits carrying the
`rebar-ticket:` trailer — `91429d4531a` (the 13-file split) and `0137b4f2de3`
(a release-note heading repair) — so the correct baseline is the parent of the first,
`9bd1d5f8124`, **not** `origin/main` (which is now 19ba's own tip and yields a
near-empty diff).

- **AC8** — `tests/unit/test_internal_shims_removed_3a46.py` grew 5 -> 6 test defs
  (parent `9bd1d5f8124` = 5, landed = 6). Strictly greater. PASS.
- **AC16** — union of the two trailer-carrying commits is **exactly** the 13 enumerated
  paths. PASS.
- **AC17** — `make verify` exited 0: 20,087 passed / 28 skipped / 43m08s.

Measured against `origin/main` = `0137b4f2de3`. Landed via Gerrit change 3165
(`LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, revision-scoped submit).
